_comment: Computer Science -- Secondary School Teachers' Diploma syllabus, Years 1-2.
First typeset 2026-10-13.
LEVEL / YEAR. Secondary School Teachers' Diploma, as the manuscript's cover and title page say;
2025 as on the copyright line (the manuscript's cover says 2026). The manuscript also carries
leftover cover text from another syllabus (Design & Technology, Senior Secondary School); the
cover and title page are drawn from the theme, so none prints.
LAID OUT BY COURSE. Year -> Term -> Course -> matrix, numbered Year.Course.Topic (1.1.1). The
engine (courseOutline) sets one level page per year, each term as a heading under it, each course
on a fresh page, and a contents list of years and courses.
MATRIX NUMBERS. renumberMatrix: the typed numbers slip in places, the table structure does not.
Counted afresh within each course:
- Course 2.2 Cyber Security was numbered 2.1.x throughout (as if it were Robotics): now 2.2.x;
- 1.8 Operating Systems, 1.9 Web Design and 2.3 Mobile Apps each ran topics 6, 8, 8: now 6, 7, 8.
CDC to confirm.
REFERENCES (setHeading, keep). Each course's reading sits under its course name; the manuscript styles the
reading labels anything from Heading 1 to plain, so six opened a page of their own and stranded the
course name above them at a page foot. Every label is a small bold label under its course, out of the contents.
